title: Show HN: Breathe CLI – Paced resonance breathing in the macOS terminal
summary: A terminal-based breathing exercise tool built by a cardiology patient (HFrEF) for paced resonance breathing at 6 breaths per minute. Built as a single Python file using only stdlib, no dependencies required.
problem_solved: Provides a frictionless daily breathing habit tool for heart patients to practice evidence-based resonance frequency breathing without app stores or accounts
why_valuable: Makes clinically-validated slow breathing therapy accessible with zero friction, based on peer-reviewed research (Bernardi et al.)
